protocol: Same byte-identical generated valid C# inputs as the Roslyn/full-parse checkpoints,256KiB/4MiB/16MiB targets. Three fresh-process runs per backend/size with three-backend rotated order. Nitride Stage22 uninstrumented --native-syntax --snapshot; Nitrogen current0.19 Runtime/Generator from pinned sources, Language.Parse one-shot and Language.ParseIncremental initial parse. All are full parses. Separate Nitrogen process per size/mode does3 full warmup parses then5 measured full parses, disposing results outside measured time. No forced GC or concurrent builds/tests. Input I/O, process launch, .NET language/module construction, result validation, JSON serialization and disposal excluded. Nitride parse phase includes its SourceText creation, dispatch preparation, persistent syntax and dependency index. Nitrogen one-shot creates flat syntax without incremental reuse table; incremental-initial includes that table. Representations and metadata differ. Warm Nitrogen is a separate control, not a warmed Nitride measurement.

nitride.counter_scope: shared recognition; syntax copies count published child payload, not newly constructed records; reparsed bytes exclude reused recognition ranges
nitride.metric: requested System bytes; no implicit flat export/semantic indexing in shared strict mode; recovery fallback is explicit; excludes caller input and OS/thread mappings
